title: fix(providers): type the upload adapter's scope from the spec's UploadScope (objectui#12055)
body:
Fixes #12055
Clause-②: no (narrowing)

## What changes

`createObjectStackUploadAdapter`'s `scope` option (`ObjectStackUploadAdapterOptions.scope` in `@object-ui/providers`) was an open `string`. It is now `API.UploadScope`: the spec's upload-scope vocabulary, `UploadScope` from `@objectstack/spec/api`, reached through the `API` namespace that `@object-ui/types` already re-exports (`export type * as API from '@objectstack/spec/api'`). This is the type half triage's answer C left on the card; the shared half (the `path` fallback removed) landed as PR #12058.

- **No hand copy, no new dependency, no new export.** `@object-ui/providers` already depends on `@object-ui/types`, and `@object-ui/types` depends on `@objectstack/spec`, so `package.json` and the lockfile do not change. The emitted `UploadProvider.d.ts` gains one type-only line, `import type { API } from '@object-ui/types'`, and the emitted JS is unchanged (the import is erased: 0 hits in `dist/UploadProvider.js`). Named here for the contract review, as the dispatch asked.
- **Docblock.** It names the values by reference to the spec type, says a value outside it does not compile and is refused by the server with `400`, and says an omitted scope sends none, so the server applies the default the spec's upload request declares. It no longer points at the `sys_file` select in `@objectstack/service-storage` as the authority.
- **Callers.** The only in-repo caller that passes a scope is `RecordAttachmentsPanel` (`scope: 'attachments'`), which is in the vocabulary and still compiles. The console's app-wide adapter passes none. Neither source file changes.

## Measured before editing (installed `@objectstack/spec` `18.0.0-next.1`)

- `UploadScopeSchema` and `type UploadScope = z.input of UploadScopeSchema` are exported from the `./api` subpath; the package root does not export them. Members: `tenant`, `user`, `private`, `temp`, `attachments` (`public` is not one). The card body's list still names `public`; the type follows the spec, so it does not apply.
- `GetPresignedUrlRequestSchema.scope` is `UploadScopeSchema.default("user")` in the installed JS.

## Pins (`packages/providers/src/__tests__/objectstack-upload-scope-12055.test.ts`)

- Compile-time, checked by `tsconfig.test.json` (chained after the source program in `type-check`):
  - the option type, without `undefined`, is exactly `API.UploadScope`, and `API.UploadScope` is not `any`;
  - an open `string` is not assignable to it;
  - `@ts-expect-error` on `{ scope: 'avatars' }` typed as `ObjectStackUploadAdapterOptions`.
- Runtime: the existing pins stay as they were: `scope: 'attachments'` is forwarded unchanged, an adapter built without a scope sends none (with or without a `path`).

## Evidence (head `7d5d8f2dd`, every run after the last commit)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/providers type-check` (echoes `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): VERDICT command-exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists the test file once, and lists the spec's `dist/api/index.d.mts`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/providers/` plus the two adapter-factory suites (`RecordAttachmentsPanel.affordanceGrant-12047`, `App.uploadAltitude-10131`): `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 23 passed (23)`; the 12055 file runs 6 tests, all passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`, after building its 29-package dependency closure at this branch: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- **Ablation** (the change committed first; mutation and restore through `ablation-replace.mjs` with an exit/int/term trap): `scope?: API.UploadScope;` widened to `scope?: string;` (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` then fails with exit 2: two TS2344 (the identity pin and the not-an-open-string pin) and TS2578 (unused `@ts-expect-error` on `'avatars'`). Restored: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Reverse probe across packages** (proves app-shell reads the rebuilt declaration, not a cached one): `RecordAttachmentsPanel`'s `scope: 'attachments'` changed to `'avatars'`, then app-shell `tsc --noEmit` fails with exit 2: TS2322, `Type '"avatars"' is not assignable to type '"tenant" | "user" | "private" | "temp" | "attachments" | undefined'`. Restored: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Local gates, each exit captured before any pipe, all 0: `check-changeset-presence` (1 changeset declared), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite` (0 modified), `check-changeset-claims`, `check-control-bytes`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` (0 new), `check-test-path-roots`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-phantom-dependencies`; `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the 3 paths: NOT GOVERNED. ESLint on the 2 touched files: 0 errors, 7 warnings (`react-refresh/only-export-components` and `react-hooks/refs`), none on a line this PR changes. Repo-wide lint and the rest of the farm are CI's.
- Not run, not owed: `check:spec-floors`, `check:self-import` (no `package.json` changes).

## Changeset

`.changeset/12055-upload-scope-type.md`: `@object-ui/providers` `minor`, with the breaking meaning (TypeScript only: a scope outside the vocabulary no longer compiles; the server already refused it) and the remedy, and `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`.

If the seat prefers one coherent CHANGELOG entry, the remedy is to delete that one sentence.
